title: Visit report
intro: Collects what has been logged, so it is easy to bring to the health station or the doctor. Look the report over before you print it.

averages.title: Average per day
averages.hint: Based on the days that were logged. Days without logs are not counted.

medicines.title: Medicine
medicines.given: {count, plural, =0 {No doses given} one {# dose given} other {# doses given}}

journal.title: Journal: health station, doctor and sickness

questions.title: Questions for the health station
questions.hint: Write what you want to remember to ask. The text is only saved on this device.
questions.placeholder: For example: How is the eating going?

footer: The report is based on what was logged in Baby Atlas and may be missing things. It does not replace the assessment of the health station or the doctor.
